name: fleet-orchestrate
description: claude-fleet orchestration: /fleet-orchestrate takes the orchestrator role (take_role) in a session that holds no issue — talk a request through, then hand it to worker sessions; its state and role ride a compaction (hooks). Dispatching from anywhere is ⌘P's ⚡ row (issue #3328); an old /qd forwards to it for one version. Not installed by default (EPIC #3111).
